description: This file implements thermistor-related functions for a firmware system, including temperature calculations, resistance conversions, and sensor configurations. It also contains initialization routines and utility functions for managing thermistor sensors used in engine temperature monitoring.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Class providing methods for thermistor temperature calculations and curve preparation.

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates resistor R1 value from voltage divider parameters.

methods.name: getR2InVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates resistor R2 value from voltage divider parameters.

methods.name: getVoutInVoltageDividor
methods.description: Calculates output voltage from resistors and input voltage.

methods.name: ThermistorMath::getKelvinTemperatureByResistance
methods.description: Returns temperature in Kelvin based on resistance using the Steinhart-Hart equation.

methods.name: convertCelsiustoF
methods.description: Converts Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit.

methods.name: convertFtoCelsius
methods.description: Converts Fahrenheit temperature to Celsius.

methods.name: convertKelvinToFahrenheit
methods.description: Converts Kelvin to Fahrenheit via Celsius.

methods.name: getResistance
methods.description: Calculates resistance based on voltage and thermistor configuration.

methods.name: getTemperatureC
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Celsius from thermistor voltage reading.

methods.name: isValidCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Checks if coolant temperature is within valid range.

methods.name: isValidIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Checks if intake air temperature is within valid range.

methods.name: hasCltSensor
methods.description: Determines if a coolant temperature sensor is present.

methods.name: getCoolantTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves coolant temperature, considering sensor presence and validity.

methods.name: setThermistorConfiguration
methods.description: Configures thermistor resistance and temperature points.

methods.name: ThermistorMath::prepareThermistorCurve
methods.description: Prepares the Steinhart-Hart curve parameters based on resistance and temperature points.

methods.name: hasIatSensor
methods.description: Checks if Intake Air Temperature sensor is available.

methods.name: getIntakeAirTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves intake air temperature with validity checks.

methods.name: setDodgeSensor
methods.description: Configures thermistor parameters for a Dodge sensor.

methods.name: setCommonNTCSensor
methods.description: Configures thermistor parameters for a common NTC sensor.

methods.name: initThermistors
methods.description: Initializes thermistor system with shared logger.
